title: Love the concept… Just hard to use!
text:
Love the concept… Just hard to use!. So, I wanted to love these so much!! How can you not have fun with a circular ice globe in your drink?! Problem is the container itself to create the ice globe is challenging at best!
This item splits through the middle must be exactly lined up together and when you fill with water.. it is hard not to have water leak out!!! Once you create the perfect seal, the other issue comes from this not aligning perfectly… So, getting a circular smooth sphere.. is nothing but, a challenge!

The price point was decent and almost too good to be true. If the product is hard to use then, it sort of renders useless!? This became more of a quest to create the perfect ice globe… Not that it matters on any important level. Just know, it is harder then it looks to create the perfect ice sphere!!

Removing the frozen ice was not difficult and expelling ice from case seemed rather easy. If any trouble- just a tad bit of warm water to outside.. let’s it come out with ease. I love what they’re trying to do in concept with this ice tray- it just misses the user friendly mark-
As for an on flavor of ice? Did not notice any… However, did not eat the ice but rather let it float in a drink. ** keep in mind the size of sphere to the cup- this could be a challenge to fit in some bar glasses If the opening to the lip is not wide enough.. our glasses fit these perfectly. These would be best use floating in a large punch bowl… However, can’t imagine trying to make enough to pull it off!
